page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual instance built on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs paired with 32.0 GB of system RAM. This configuration maintains an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, yielding 8.0 GB of memory per core.

The hardware configuration includes 4 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and operates without onboard local storage or dedicated GPU accelerators. All persistent storage must be connected via external block storage volumes, and network ingress does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance relies entirely on dedicated vCPU allocation rather than shared or burstable compute threads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the resource profile prioritizes high RAM density over excessive core counts, preventing over-provisioning of CPU resources for workloads constrained primarily by memory capacity. Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.xlarge is designed for in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, distributed memory caches, medium-scale relational databases, and enterprise data processing tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8475B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU distribution. The instance operates without integrated local storage or hardware GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached storage solutions, and includes a baseline network throughput of 4 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By provisioning a high memory-to-core ratio, the platform offers an efficient resource allocation model for memory-bound tasks without requiring excess compute cores. It is suited for in-memory key-value databases, caching systems, relational database deployments, and memory-intensive enterprise application workloads.
